expected_prisoner.name: Thomas Burans
expected_prisoner.description: Thomas Burans, also recorded as Burns, was a laborer living in Ronan. He was convicted of sedition for urging a draft registrant not to enlist and criticizing the persecution of the Industrial Workers of the World. He entered Deer Lodge on May 25, 1918, and was paroled on June 8, 1919. He was returned for a parole violation on November 15, 1919, and died at Warm Springs in 1926.
